result.summary: VERIFY_ONLY audit of World State Snapshot and AGM Decision Envelope contracts for the provider-neutral Paid AGM gateway. Free Desktop Bridge and Paid API share identical payload semantics (edition + optional non-authoritative transport only). Gateway MUST: redact deny-list secrets before any provider interface call; validate snapshot schema; call fixture provider only in tests; validate decision schema; return an untrusted proposal that cannot bypass consent/preview/executor/World Commit. Error envelopes, idempotency, budget caps and retry policy are specified for A1 network sole writer under services/agm_gateway/**. Real provider selection remains HITL_REQUIRED. No product or contracts edits in this wave.

in_scope: Snapshot/Decision Free vs Paid identity (edition + optional transport)
Gateway validation ORDER and redaction deny-list
Untrusted decision / no durable-mutation bypass invariants
Structured error envelope categories (no secrets/raw prompts)
Budget fields (estimate, per_request_cap, session_cap) and pre-dispatch reject
Godot client never holds provider secrets
Fixture provider only for tests; real provider HITL_REQUIRED
Acceptance tests matrix for gateway smoke
out_of_scope: Product implementation under services/agm_gateway/** (A1 sole writer)
Godot paid gateway adapter (A2 executor sole writer)
Free/Paid edition UI selection runtime (A3 core VERIFY_ONLY)
Real provider calls, credentials, outbound network enablement
Provider SDKs in Godot or gateway
Dependency install, push, deploy, public listener

authority_boundary.architecture_lock: Paid edition: API adapter behind trusted gateway; credentials never in Godot client or world files

boundary_checklist.check: Free Desktop Bridge and Paid API share identical Snapshot/Decision payload semantics; only edition (and optional non-authoritative transport on snapshots) may differ
evidence: contracts/agm/world_state_snapshot.schema.json description + edition enum desktop_bridge_free|api_paid + optional transport

static_comparison.note: valid_decision_api_paid.json still carries provider_label=desktop_bridge / model_receipt_ref bridge:manual — non-secret trace labels only; does not alter decision semantics. A1 fixture provider may set provider_label=fixture_provider or gateway_route_fixture for paid path tests without changing payload semantics.

boundary_checklist.check: Gateway processing order is fixed: redact secrets → validate snapshot schema → (fixture provider only in tests) → validate decision schema → return untrusted proposal

order.name: redact_secrets
order.action: Deep-strip deny-list keys and value patterns from inbound request/snapshot (and any wrapper metadata) BEFORE schema validation and BEFORE any provider interface call
order.fail_closed: If redaction cannot complete safely, reject with error category=validation (or policy if intentional smuggling detected); never forward original payload

order.name: validate_snapshot_schema
order.action: Validate redacted body against contracts/agm/world_state_snapshot.schema.json (Draft 2020-12). Require edition=api_paid for paid gateway path (or accept both editions if adapter is dual-mode, but G5 paid adapter uses api_paid).

order.name: budget_and_policy_precheck
order.action: Compute estimate; compare per_request_cap and session_cap; check allowlisted provider interface mode (fixture only unless HITL). Reject before dispatch if cap would be exceeded or negative balance.
order.fail_closed: category=budget or policy; no provider call

order.name: idempotency_lookup
order.action: If gateway_request_id/request_id already completed, return prior safe response (decision or error envelope) without re-dispatch
order.fail_closed: Replays must not double-bill or double-call provider

order.name: provider_interface_call
order.action: Call ProviderInterface.generate_decision(redacted_snapshot, context). G5-001: FixtureProvider only. Real provider selection HITL_REQUIRED and denied by default.
order.fail_closed: timeout → category=timeout; unavailable → category=provider_unavailable; after retry budget exhausted → category=retry_exhausted

order.name: validate_decision_schema
order.action: Validate provider output against contracts/agm/decision_envelope.schema.json. Re-apply redaction/deny-list on decision. Enforce build_proposals locks (preview_required=true, confirmation_state=pending, routes_through=preview_confirm_commit).
order.fail_closed: category=validation; do not return raw provider text

order.name: return_untrusted_proposal
order.action: Return Decision Envelope as untrusted proposal. Gateway MUST NOT invoke World Commit, auto-consent, preview confirm, or durable mutation.
order.fail_closed: N/A — success path still untrusted at client/executor

boundary_checklist.check: Deny-list fields must be stripped before any provider interface call; schema propertyNames also ban them at root
runtime_redaction_rules: Strip deny-list keys at every object depth (not root-only); schema propertyNames is root-level — gateway redaction must be deep
Strip header-like fields if present on gateway request wrappers: Authorization, X-Api-Key, Cookie, Bearer tokens
Never log raw deny-list values; logs may record field_name_stripped counts only
invalid_snapshot_with_api_key.json is schema-invalid and must also fail gateway redaction/validation path
Match Free Desktop Bridge FORBIDDEN_KEYS from game/scripts/modules/bridge/snapshot_builder.gd and decision_import_guard.gd FORBIDDEN_TOP

boundary_checklist.check: Returned Decision Envelope remains untrusted; cannot bypass consent, preview, executor, or World Commit
rules: AGM cannot mutate durable world state from snapshot or decision
build_proposals items force preview_required=true, confirmation_state=pending, routes_through=preview_confirm_commit
Direct durable mutation fields banned (commit_request, durable_mutation, scene_tree_mutation, direct_world_write, script/code)
Client path after gateway: import/guard → visible consent (paid adapter) → executor soft effects → world_prompt preview → player confirm → World Commit only
Gateway success does not imply consent or commit
Same executor path as Free Desktop Bridge (ARCHITECTURE_LOCK first-run editions share validator and World Commit boundary)

boundary_checklist.check: Structured error envelope distinguishes failure classes without leaking secrets or raw hidden prompts

envelope_shape.schema_hint: aidle_agm_gateway_error_v1 (runtime shape; not a contracts/ edit this wave)

field_rules.error: const true (or omit ok true path)
field_rules.code: stable machine code e.g. snapshot_schema_invalid, budget_per_request_exceeded, provider_timeout
field_rules.message: short safe human string; no secrets, no full system prompts, no raw provider stack dumps
field_rules.trace_id: correlation id from snapshot.trace_id when available
field_rules.retryable: true only for timeout|provider_unavailable before exhaustion; false for validation|policy|budget|auth-like failures and retry_exhausted
field_rules.details: optional object of non-secret diagnostics (field paths, caps, attempt counts) — never raw deny-list values

boundary_checklist.check: Idempotency key fields for gateway requests

request_id.role: Client-supplied idempotency key for a single paid AGM turn
request_id.scope: per session / per gateway deployment store

gateway_request_id.role: Gateway-assigned or client-echoed stable id; may equal request_id if client is sole source
gateway_request_id.rule: Identical request_id (or gateway_request_id) + same session_id MUST return the same outcome without re-calling provider after first completion

decision_id.role: Downstream executor idempotency for applied decisions (existing contract)
decision_id.note: Distinct from gateway request idempotency; replay of decision_id is rejected by decision import guard / executor policy

snapshot_id.role: source_snapshot_id binding; stale mismatch is client/executor policy, not re-dispatch

store_requirements: Record completed request_id → response fingerprint (decision_id or error category/code)
Bounded TTL optional; G5 MVP in-memory OK for fixture tests

boundary_checklist.check: Budget estimate + hard caps; reject before provider dispatch if exceeded; no negative balance

estimate.description: Gateway-computed cost/units estimate for this request before dispatch

per_request_cap.description: Hard max units/cost allowed for a single request

session_cap.description: Hard max cumulative units/cost for the session

session_spent.description: Running total; reject if session_spent + estimate > session_cap

rules: If estimate > per_request_cap → reject category=budget, code=budget_per_request_exceeded, no provider call
If session_spent + estimate > session_cap → reject category=budget, code=budget_session_exceeded, no provider call
session_spent never goes negative; failed pre-dispatch rejects do not charge
On successful dispatch accounting, session_spent += actual_or_estimate (fixture: estimate)
Budget fields may live on gateway request context / gateway config — not required on Snapshot schema (contracts untouched)

boundary_checklist.check: Retry only for timeout/provider_unavailable; NEVER retry validation/policy/auth failures
also_never_retry: auth failures (map to policy or dedicated non-retryable code if exposed)

parameters.max_attempts: bounded small integer (recommend 2-3 total attempts including first)
parameters.timeout_ms: bounded per-attempt timeout (fixture provider may inject fake delay for tests)
parameters.backoff: deterministic fixed or linear for tests; no unbounded loops

boundary_checklist.check: Godot client must never hold provider secrets, API keys, client secrets, bearer tokens, or provider SDKs
rules: Paid path: Godot → trusted gateway only; gateway owns authentication
No API key / session cookie / Desktop AI credential / auth token in Godot, clipboard snapshots, bridge files, logs, saves or prompt recipes (ARCHITECTURE_LOCK Forbidden paths)
A2 paid adapter under game/scripts/modules/bridge/** must not import provider SDKs
Free Desktop Bridge uses_network()==false and is comparison baseline for same Snapshot/Decision contracts
Server-side credential provider boundary only
evidence: game/scripts/modules/bridge/* free path comparison (no network, redacted snapshots)

boundary_checklist.check: G5-001 uses deterministic fixture provider only; real provider selection is HITL_REQUIRED
rules: ProviderInterface abstraction is provider-neutral
FixtureProvider returns schema-valid decisions from contracts/fixtures/agm/valid/* (or gateway test fixtures derived from them)
Default deny outbound network and real providers
Provider/domain allowlisting and real network enablement remain HITL
No provider SDK dependency in gateway for G5-001
Selecting a non-fixture provider without HITL approval is forbidden

boundary_checklist.check: services/agm_gateway/ exists as ownership root but has no product implementation yet — A1 sole writer
boundary_checklist.evidence: services/agm_gateway/ (empty tree at A0 audit time)
